segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: Book twelve. The Sirens. Rowers, stroke.

segments.speaker: director
segments.caption: Action.

segments.speaker: director
segments.caption: They look like a loop.

segments.speaker: cinematographer
segments.caption: One clock. A stroke every two point six seconds.

segments.speaker: crew-at-the-oars-2
segments.caption: I'm four hundredths of a stroke late.

segments.speaker: crew-at-the-oars-3
segments.caption: Three hundredths of a stroke early.

segments.speaker: crew-at-the-oars-5
segments.caption: I don't row. I steer.

segments.speaker: the-sirens-4
segments.caption: We sing on a clock of our own.

segments.speaker: director
segments.caption: Print it.

segments.speaker: crew-at-the-oars-2
segments.caption: What?

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: Wax in their ears. It's in the scene.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: I'll check on all of you at the top of the hour.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: Book five, on the same boat. Calypso, your trees. Odysseus, beside her.

segments.speaker: director
segments.caption: Action.

segments.speaker: calypso
segments.caption: Here at the island's edge the tall trees stand: alder, and poplar, and sky-high fir.

segments.speaker: director
segments.caption: Where is Calypso?

segments.speaker: cinematographer
segments.caption: Behind the back of his head.

segments.speaker: odysseus
segments.caption: I'm the lead.

segments.speaker: cinematographer
segments.caption: Take one. Twenty-four seconds of her lines, behind his head.

segments.speaker: calypso
segments.caption: Seven years I kept him. One take, and he's in front of me.

segments.speaker: director
segments.caption: Apart.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: He means: a man's height apart.

segments.speaker: calypso
segments.caption: Here at the island's edge the tall trees stand: alder, and poplar, and sky-high fir.

segments.speaker: cinematographer
segments.caption: Her face. And the bow on his back is still across the frame.

segments.speaker: director
segments.caption: Keep it.

segments.speaker: odysseus
segments.caption: Do I still get the raft?

segments.speaker: calypso
segments.caption: Four days. You build it yourself.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: That's a wrap on the sea.

segments.speaker: crew-at-the-oars-5
segments.caption: I'll steer us home.
